review.status: sound timing judged in solo renders on all four examples (two-statements 1 of 1, color-block 8 of 8, app-film 12 of 12, all-kinds 33 of 33 cues; every hit within 0.15 ms); sound.py check on whole effects tracks reports not_judged (color-block) and partly_judged (app-film, 7 of 12) with exit 3 instead of a silent pass; a contract with '</script>' in its copy embedded by previewFor opened in Chromium (data-ready, no injected element) and the raw embedding is rejected by check-preview.mjs; reading-time rule identical in check-score.mjs and critique.py on sample texts; no example contract changes its warnings; Python renderer and browser engine compared pixel by pixel on color-block and app-film in the browser suite
